entries.en: Two engines met and this is what they painted
entries.body_en: One engine grows the trees, the other grinds the paint. Together they finish a landscape from one number, and this card is world 23497.
entries._audit_body_en: Curated address pg|world=23497. This engine was CONVERGENCE; renamed PANGEA by the orchestrator 2026-08-23 (names the result — the one continent the drifting pieces became; tagline EVERYTHING ARRIVES AT ONCE). Address prefix pg|; doorway https://persona500.com/pangea#pg|world=N. At page-build time the local engine copy read ?world=N from the query string and did not yet read the hash; the hash reader belongs to the engine lane. Faces rendered by a later step.
